findings.summary: billable_hours subtracts two aware datetimes sharing the same ZoneInfo, so Python uses wall-clock difference and ignores UTC offset, giving wrong durations (over/undercharging by an hour) for sessions spanning a DST transition; convert both to UTC before subtracting.

judge.reason: Identifies same-tzinfo wall-clock subtraction causing DST duration errors, fix is UTC conversion.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: New tests only use July sessions and do not cover a session crossing a DST boundary; a DST-crossing test should be added.

judge.reason: Finding that tests fail to cover the DST answer-key bug is always valid_other.

findings.label: valid_other
